data.name: Groupe Bordet
data.description: Groupe Bordet is a French industrial group based in Leuglay (Burgundy) that has produced wood charcoal since 1860 using its patented Carboépuré® continuous pyrolysis process, serving charcoal markets including food, BBQ, aluminum smelting and activated carbon. It has expanded into Puro.earth-certified biochar (via partner Carbonapp) and bio-oils, and is investing over €30M — with €14.1M support from Bpifrance — in a new plant at Decize targeting 15,000 t/year of biochar plus bio-oils by 2027.
